method: Source-only lexical navigation followed by complete scientific-body inspection of plausible related reviews. Labels preserve material outcomes, numbers, populations and context. Gap means no substantively useful answer was identified, not proof that no possible interpretation has related material. Original title-only questions remain unchanged in private evaluation staging; this file does not redistribute them.

rejectedRelatedReview.reason: An antibiotic-associated diarrhea review does not establish the microbiological identity or health benefit of a different beverage. Its own body warns against extending one strain's evidence to every food or supplement.
